newsitem.title: USA: NYNEX executive Donald Reed to resign-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: NYNEX executive Donald Reed to resign-WSJ.

text.p: NYNEX Corp President and Group Executive for External Affairs Donald Reed plans to resign to become chief executive of a telecommunications-related company, the New York Times reported, citing executives at NYNEX.
Reed's departure will upset the board of directors' balance of power at the new company formed by Bell Atlantic's $23 billion acquisition of NYNEX, the paper said.
Each company is allotted three board seats.
NYNEX will have to choose from less prominent executives to fill Reed's spot, the paper said.
The name of Reed's new company could not be learned, the paper said.
